output.reason: The brief compares segments (no-connector accounts flat whether repriced or not, Quillbook accounts up whether price-locked or not) and accounts for the seat-size confound, so it convincingly separates sync failures from pricing as the cause, and it gives clear, prioritised actions, though several of its key figures can't be checked against the evidence I have.
